complexity.notes: Dropping the len==2 special case was the right call: with two elements the loop never runs and min(mid, big) is exactly the old base-case answer, so it folds in cleanly. The while-loop with a manual i counter could be a for-loop over range(len(cost)-3, -1, -1), which reads more idiomatically.
complexity.summary: Bottom-up DP from the end of the array, keeping only the best costs to reach the top from the two floors ahead, so each index is visited once with constant extra space.
